title: Pure Doodle Beast
summary: Doodle Beast is a hand-drawn Dinosaur Tribute Summon control archetype consisting of Doodle Beast - Stego, Doodle Beast - Tyranno, and Doodlebook - Uh uh uh!. Stego Special Summons itself to search and discard Doodlebook, while Tyranno Tribute Summons itself as a Quick Effect during the opponent's Main Phase by Tributing a Dinosaur to destroy a monster and gain half its ATK.

allow.Souleating Oviraptor: Searches Doodle Beast - Stego or Doodle Beast - Tyranno on Normal/Special Summon and destroys Babycerasaurus to revive a Dinosaur.
allow.Miscellaneousaurus: Protects all Dinosaurs on the field from opponent's activated effects and summons Animadorned Archosaur from the Deck.
allow.Babycerasaurus: Summons Souleating Oviraptor or another Babycerasaurus from the Deck when destroyed by card effect.
allow.Petiteranodon: Summons Level 5 Doodle Beast - Stego directly from the Deck when destroyed by card effect.
allow.Animadorned Archosaur: Destroys Babycerasaurus or Petiteranodon in hand to search Double Evolution Pill.
allow.Fossil Dig: Searches Doodle Beast - Stego, Souleating Oviraptor, or Miscellaneousaurus.
allow.Double Evolution Pill: Summons Doodle Beast - Tyranno or Ultimate Conductor Tyranno from the Deck.
allow.Evolzar Lars: Rank 6 Dinosaur-material Xyz that detaches 1 material to negate any face-up card on the opponent's field.
allow.Evolzar Laggia: Rank 4 Xyz made with two Level 4 Dinosaurs for omni-negation.
allow.Evolzar Dolkka: Rank 4 Xyz made with two Level 4 Dinosaurs for monster effect negation.

main: Level 5 EARTH Dinosaur that Special Summons itself from the hand if you control no monsters or only Dinosaurs, searches any 'Doodlebook' Spell/Trap, and then discards 1 card.

Signature Level 8 FIRE Dinosaur boss: can be Tribute Summoned with 1 Dinosaur; Quick Effect during the Main Phase to Tribute Summon itself from hand, then destroys 1 monster on the field and gains half its ATK if Tributed with a Doodle Beast.
Signature Normal Trap: negates an attack that targets your Dinosaur and Special Summons a Doodle Beast from the GY; banishes itself to search any Level 5 or higher Dinosaur.
Searches Doodle Beast - Stego or Doodle Beast - Tyranno on Summon.
Discards itself to make your Dinosaurs unaffected by opponent's activated effects during the Main Phase.
Special Summons Level 5 Doodle Beast - Stego directly from the Deck when destroyed by Oviraptor or Archosaur.
Pops Petiteranodon to summon Doodle Beast - Stego from the Deck while searching Double Evolution Pill.
Searches Doodle Beast - Stego or Souleating Oviraptor.
Summons a high-level Dinosaur from the Deck.
extra: Rank 4 Dragon Xyz made with two Level 4 Dinosaurs to negate Summons and Spells/Traps.
Rank 4 Dragon Xyz made with two Level 4 Dinosaurs to negate monster effects.
Rank 6 Dragon Xyz that provides face-up card negation.
